evidence_basis.disclosure: The v1 failures and three trained KDA generation counterexamples are known. V2 is a prospective expansion to a source-balanced case stream; it does not relabel prior results.

case_stream.source_balance: three short cases and one 4K case from each of 11 validation sources

checkpoint_source.limitation: The historical dense control has one seed and a 2.08% parameter mismatch; v2 calibrates runtime behavior, not architecture quality.

execution.dtype: BF16 activations with FP32 parameters and recurrent state where implemented
execution.full_path: recompute the complete common-history prefix at every generation step
execution.cached_path: one full prefill followed by one-token stateful decode
execution.case_failure_policy: retain non-finite, interrupted, OOM, and unevaluable cases; no silent replacement

strict_operator_state_export.rule: existing isolated operator, state, gradient, checkpoint, and CPU Transformers export parity thresholds remain mandatory

common_history_argmax_disagreement.estimand: candidate-minus-control disagreement rate with within-case steps kept together

high_margin_argmax_disagreement.unit: case with eligible steps pooled inside the case
high_margin_argmax_disagreement.estimand: candidate-minus-control disagreement rate among full-path margins at or above 0.1 logits

early_free_running_divergence.event: cached and recompute greedy tokens first differ before 32 generated tokens

hard_guardrails: no cached/recompute disagreement when the full-path top-1/top-2 margin is at least 0.5 logits
every strict operator/state/export prerequisite remains passed

statistics.length_decision: every endpoint and hard guardrail must pass separately at 8, 64, 512, and 4096 tokens
statistics.candidate_decision: each KDA seed must pass separately; no averaging away a failed seed
statistics.multiplicity: intersection-union gate across endpoints, lengths, and seeds; every cell must pass

phase_order: materialize and pin the provenance-only case stream
evaluate and hash the dense control only
write the immutable control-lock artifact containing the fixed margins and dense report hash
evaluate KDA seeds 42/43/44 only after the lock timestamp
apply paired case bootstrap and hard guardrails
rerun the Paper 1 baseline hardware preflight only if v2 passes
decision_scope: V2 may qualify full-model CUDA cache behavior for the historical KDA topology or keep it blocked. It cannot weaken strict operator correctness, claim model quality, promote an architecture, or authorize paper-scale training.
